_comment: Changing anything here invalidates every measurement taken before the change.
If a prompt must change, add a new one with a new id and keep the old.
Every field is deliberate: max_tokens is fixed so runs are comparable, and
temperature is 0 everywhere so output can be hashed and compared exactly.
